old_description: Customer forged since 1997! For 25 years ARC fabricators has been locally owned and operated in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. about:
ARC Fabricators has been locally owned and operated in Sioux Falls, South Dakota since its founding in 1997. The company began as a steel fabrication and painting shop and has grown into a full-service provider for projects of any scale.

The shop offers custom steel fabrication, industrial painting, and engineering support. Capabilities include design and CAD services, plasma cutting, press brake forming, rolling, shearing, sandblasting, and painting in a dedicated blast and paint facility. Field welding and installation are performed by AWS and AISC certified welders using fully equipped service trucks. The company also handles structural steel fabrication, equipment repair, and plant and equipment design for commercial and residential customers.

ARC Fabricators works with both small and large companies, supplying custom fabricated steel equipment, structural components, stairs, railings, and miscellaneous steel for commercial construction, residential projects, and industrial plant equipment.

The company emphasizes a single-source approach from conception to completion, noting that its state-of-the-art blast and paint systems reduce cost and lead times while delivering a superior finish. Its stated goal is to provide solutions that exceed customer expectations.

name: ARF Solar LLC
old_description: ARF Solar is here to deliver sustainable, cost-efficient solutions. With a focus on excellence in every aspect, from customer service to technical execution, we are committed to making a positive impact in the industry and beyond.
about:
ARF Solar LLC is based in Cottage Hills, Illinois, in the Metro East region near St. Louis. The company was founded in 1996 and has since focused on solar installation services for residential and commercial customers. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, but the company emphasizes its local roots and union-built approach.

The firm provides end-to-end solar solutions, handling design, engineering, permitting, installation, and ongoing monitoring entirely in-house. Its services include rooftop and ground-mount photovoltaic systems, battery storage, and backup generators. The company works with programs such as Illinois Shines and Illinois Solar for All to offer financing, power purchase agreements, and no-cost installations for income-eligible households.

ARF Solar serves homeowners, businesses, schools, fire stations, churches, and multi-family affordable housing. Recent projects cited include a carport and ground-mount array for a school district, rooftop installations for a fire station and a church, and a multi-tenant low-income building.

The company says its differentiation lies in its union-trained IBEW craftsmen, fully in-house project management, and commitment to making solar accessible regardless of income. Its stated values include uncompromising integrity, unparalleled performance, empowerment through access, and local community investment.

name: ASYST Automation
old_description: ASYST provides reliable, efficient, and innovative automation and robotics solutions for manufacturers across many industries. From basic fixturing to fully automated turnkey systems, we leverage advanced technology and experienced engineering to help customers capture operational efficiencies, reduce the impact of labor, and improve product quality.
about:
ASYST Automation is based in Kenosha, Wisconsin. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the provided materials.

The company delivers custom automation and robotics solutions ranging from benchtop test fixtures to fully integrated turnkey assembly lines. Its capabilities include custom assembly systems, rotary dial and palletized conveyor systems, magnetic conveyance, robotic integration as a FANUC Authorized Systems Integrator, 3D random bin picking, machine vision inspection, and various feeding and handling technologies. ASYST operates under a dual business model: a Manufacturing Partnership Model where it produces automotive components in its own facility using injection molding and assembly expertise, and a Turnkey Equipment Sales Model where it designs, builds, and installs automation systems at the customer's site. The product portfolio includes aiming adjusters, ball pivots, pivot studs, automotive cables, heat sinks, tolerance compensators, tail lamp fasteners, rotors, stators, and automation equipment.

ASYST serves manufacturers across automotive and transportation, medical devices and healthcare, consumer products, packaging, electronics, industrial, agriculture, aerospace, and military and defense sectors.

The company emphasizes its in-house vision lab for pre-validation, proven technology validated in its own production, and comprehensive support services including installation, factory acceptance testing, training, and preventive maintenance. Its quality system is certified to IATF 16949:2016, ISO 9001:2015, and ISO 14001:2015.

old_description: As one of the industry’s most advanced steel fabricators, ATACO Steel Products has the manufacturing capabilities to produce the deep draw stamped parts and metal stamping components you need. When companies need deep draw metal stamping or custom metal fabrication, we're the sheet metal components manufacturer they turn to. We offer metal stamping, deep draw stamping, custom metal laser cutting, comprehensive fabrication services, secondary forming and finishing processes, and more to meet your unique requirements.
about:
ATACO Steel Products Corporation, a privately owned manufacturer of metal stampings, has operated from Cedarburg, Wisconsin since its founding in 1946. The company began as a deep draw stamping specialist and has grown into a full-service metal fabrication partner.

The company produces deep drawn metal stampings up to 16 inches in depth of draw, alongside conventional metal stamping, 3D 5-axis laser cutting, 2D laser cutting and press brake fabrication, robotic and manual welding, and sheet metal engineering services including pre-design feasibility, design for manufacturability, and PFMEA. An in-house Cut & Etch Lab supports weld evaluation to AWS D1.1, ISO 3834, and AWS 14.3 standards. The facility houses coordinate measuring machines, laser scanning systems, and a range of hardness and functional gaging equipment.

ATACO serves original equipment manufacturers in agriculture, commercial food equipment, construction, lawn and garden, material handling, military, powersports, rail, and sustainability sectors. Customers include agricultural equipment builders, rail component suppliers, and construction machinery OEMs who rely on the shop for high-tonnage, close-tolerance stampings and fabricated assemblies such as tanks, reservoirs, and deep drawn shells.

The company emphasizes engineering collaboration, tooling-free laser trim and pierce operations, and an internal test lab that reduces third-party inspection lead times. Its fundamentals stress consistent quality, on-time delivery, and a culture of continuous improvement across its quality management system.

name: ATEX Technologies, Inc.
old_description: ATEX specializes in implantable textiles and custom medical textile solutions for device manufacturers. With 20+ years of experience in implantable fabric and medical device fabric, we design custom medical textile components that support innovative, life-changing technologies. Don't hesitate to reach out now!
about:
ATEX Technologies, Inc. was founded in 2006 in Pinebluff, North Carolina. The company was created to address the need for high-quality textiles exclusively for implantable medical devices, backed by an organization capable of meeting demanding regulatory and quality requirements.

The company engineers custom implantable medical textile components using knitting, weaving, braiding, and non-woven technologies. Its capabilities span yarn development, textile formation, finishing, testing, and validation — all performed in-house. ATEX works with materials such as PET (for which it holds an FDA Master File), polypropylene, ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene, liquid crystal polymer, and other thermoplastics.

ATEX serves medical device manufacturers across clinical specialties including vascular and structural heart, orthopedic and robotic surgery, general surgery, and neurology and regenerative medicine. Its components — sheets, rings, tubes, tapers, and complex 3D structures — are designed to integrate into customers' devices, from fenestrated grafts and heart valve leaflets to medical scaffolds.

ATEX distinguishes itself as a medical textile solutions partner rather than a contract manufacturer, emphasizing engineering collaboration, innovation, and a relationship-first approach. The company cites four pillars — Technology, Innovation, Quality, and Character — and has invested in mistake-proofing systems to mitigate risk and ensure consistency throughout the product life cycle.

name: AVX Corporation
old_description: KYOCERA AVX is a leading global manufacturer of advanced electronic components engineered to accelerate technological innovation and build a better future. With an expansive global footprint comprised of several dozen research, development, and manufacturing facilities spanning more than 15 countries, we utilize our talented personnel dedicated to innovation, component quality and customer service to enable a brighter future through technology.
about:
KYOCERA AVX, headquartered in Fountain Inn, South Carolina, traces its origins to 1922 when Radiola Wireless was established in New York City. Through a series of transformations—including the Aerovox era and the founding of Electrical Reactance Corp in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina—the company was formally incorporated as AVX Corporation in 1972. A 1990 merger with Japan’s Kyocera Corporation led to full ownership by Kyocera in 2020, and the business adopted the KYOCERA AVX brand in 2021.

The company designs and manufactures a broad portfolio of advanced electronic components, including capacitors, connectors, antennas, filters, crystal devices, sensing and control modules, diodes, varistors, fuses, inductors, couplers, thermal management solutions, thermistors, resistive products, and SAW devices. It operates several dozen research, development, and manufacturing facilities across more than 15 countries, supported by a global workforce of over 15,000 engineers, researchers, technicians, and specialists. Core capabilities include custom design services and laser direct structuring (LDS) manufacturing.

KYOCERA AVX serves customers in automotive, aerospace, medical, industrial, military and defense, consumer electronics, 5G and IoT, aviation, automation, renewables, and high-temperature applications. Its components are engineered for mission-critical systems ranging from automotive power supplies and satellite communications to medical implants and industrial sensors.

The company emphasizes a “zero defect” quality culture, continuous improvement of its quality management systems, and an employee-first philosophy that it credits for its collaborative innovation. Its stated mission is to innovate technologies and products for tomorrow’s solutions while delivering superior customer satisfaction.

The company employs more than 12,000 people across urban and rural communities in India, reflecting a commitment to broad accessibility.

Abbott develops and manufactures a diverse portfolio spanning pharmaceuticals, nutritional products, medical devices, and diagnostic solutions. Its product lines include biowearables such as the FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring system, nutritional brands like Ensure and Glucerna, and technologies across cardiovascular, diabetes care, diagnostics, and pain management. The company offers over 400 pharmaceutical brands in India alone, supported by large-scale manufacturing and distribution networks.

The company serves hospitals, medical environments, and healthcare providers across India and globally. Its products reach patients managing diabetes, cardiovascular conditions, nutritional needs, and chronic pain, as well as clinical laboratories requiring diagnostic testing solutions. Abbott’s network extends into practically every corner of the Indian subcontinent.

Abbott states that its mission is driven by a belief that healthcare should not be a privilege reserved for the few, guiding its efforts to deliver life-changing technologies across diverse populations.
